# --- claude-ox: run Claude Code against OpenRouter's stealth/ox-alpha model ---
# Scoped to this invocation only (env prefix) — never touches your cached
# Anthropic Pro login or affects plain `claude` calls, in this or any other shell.
#
# Hardening added 2026-08-24 after repeated "empty or malformed response" /
# upstream rate-limit failures on stealth/ox-alpha (a brand-new OpenRouter
# preview model — confirmed upstream flakiness on their shared pool, not a
# local proxy/config bug):
#   - --fallback-model only kicks in for non-interactive `claude-ox --print ...`
#     calls (Claude Code's own limitation — it's a no-op in the normal
#     interactive session), so scripted/one-shot uses now fail over to a
#     stable model automatically instead of hard-failing.
#   - For the interactive TUI (the common case): if the process itself dies
#     abnormally soon after launch, this auto-reattaches with `--continue`
#     (same fix that worked manually before) instead of silently dropping
#     the session. If ox-alpha instead stays *up* but a turn errors out
#     inline (the more common failure shape — the session is fine, just that
#     reply), nothing here can retype it for you: retry the turn, or run
#     `/model` inside the session to switch models for the rest of that turn.
export OPENROUTER_API_KEY="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"
claude-ox() {
  local attempt=1 max_attempts=3 args=("$@") start end elapsed status

  while (( attempt <= max_attempts )); do
    start=$(date +%s)
    env \
      ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL="https://openrouter.ai/api" \
      ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN="$OPENROUTER_API_KEY" \
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="" \
      CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY=1 \
      CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS=1000000 \
      claude --model stealth/ox-alpha --fallback-model claude-sonnet-5,claude-opus-4-8 "${args[@]}"
    status=$?
    end=$(date +%s)
    elapsed=$(( end - start ))

    # Clean/deliberate exit (Ctrl+D, /exit, etc.) — don't touch it.
    if (( status == 0 )); then
      return 0
    fi

    # Abnormal exit shortly after start looks like a crash, not a real quit —
    # reattach to the same conversation instead of losing it.
    if (( elapsed < 15 && attempt < max_attempts )); then
      echo "claude-ox: exited abnormally after ${elapsed}s (attempt $attempt/$max_attempts) — reattaching with --continue..." >&2
      args=(--continue)
      attempt=$(( attempt + 1 ))

# --- claude-ox: run Claude Code against OpenRouter's stealth/ox-alpha model ---
# Scoped to this invocation only (env prefix) — never touches your cached
# Anthropic Pro login or affects plain `claude` calls, in this or any other shell.

# Hardening added 2026-08-24 after repeated "empty or malformed response" /
# upstream rate-limit failures on stealth/ox-alpha (a brand-new OpenRouter
# preview model — confirmed upstream flakiness on their shared pool, not a
# local proxy/config bug):
#   - --fallback-model only kicks in for non-interactive `claude-ox --print ...`
#     calls (Claude Code's own limitation — it's a no-op in the normal
#     interactive session), so scripted/one-shot uses now fail over to a
#     stable model automatically instead of hard-failing.
#   - For the interactive TUI (the common case): if the process itself dies
#     abnormally soon after launch, this auto-reattaches with `--continue`
#     (same fix that worked manually before) instead of silently dropping
#     the session. If ox-alpha instead stays *up* but a turn errors out
#     inline (the more common failure shape — the session is fine, just that
#     reply), nothing here can retype it for you: retry the turn, or run
#     `/model` inside the session to switch models for the rest of that turn.

claude-ox() {
  local attempt=1 max_attempts=3 args=("$@") start end elapsed status

  while (( attempt <= max_attempts )); do
    start=$(date +%s)
    env \
      ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL="https://openrouter.ai/api" \
      ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN="$OPENROUTER_API_KEY" \
      ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="" \
      CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY=1 \
      CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS=1000000 \
      claude --model stealth/ox-alpha --fallback-model claude-sonnet-5,claude-opus-4-8 "${args[@]}"
    status=$?
    end=$(date +%s)
    elapsed=$(( end - start ))

    # Clean/deliberate exit (Ctrl+D, /exit, etc.) — don't touch it.
    if (( status == 0 )); then
      return 0
    fi

    # Abnormal exit shortly after start looks like a crash, not a real quit —
    # reattach to the same conversation instead of losing it.
    if (( elapsed < 15 && attempt < max_attempts )); then
      echo "claude-ox: exited abnormally after ${elapsed}s (attempt $attempt/$max_attempts) — reattaching with --continue..." >&2

      attempt=$(( attempt + 1 ))
      sleep 2
      continue
    fi

    return "$status"
